Module com.hft.systems.affinity
Package com.faster.affinity.core

Class HugepageManager

java.lang.Object
com.faster.affinity.core.HugepageManager
public class HugepageManager extends Object
HugepageManager provides control over transparent hugepages for HFT applications. Transparent hugepages can significantly reduce TLB misses, improving performance for memory-intensive workloads.
